executive_summary: The forecast adherence KPI for the ANZ Client Core queue was 66.1%, which is below the threshold of 10%. This indicates that the actual offered volume was significantly lower than the forecasted volume. The investigation suggests that the miss is likely due to a systematic forecast bias and an inherited issue from a higher level, specifically the Business Org level.
business_impact: The low forecast adherence may result in underutilization of resources and potential loss of revenue.

ranked_root_causes.title: Inherited Issue from Business Org Level
ranked_root_causes.explanation: The same miss is already visible at the Business Org level, indicating that the issue is not specific to this queue but rather a broader problem.
ranked_root_causes.business_impact: The issue may affect multiple queues and require a more comprehensive solution.
ranked_root_causes.recommended_action: Investigate and address the issue at the Business Org level.

ranked_root_causes.title: Systematic Forecast Bias
ranked_root_causes.explanation: The chronic bias feature indicates a consistent over-forecasting issue, which may be contributing to the low adherence.
ranked_root_causes.business_impact: The bias may be affecting multiple forecasts and require adjustments to the forecasting process.
ranked_root_causes.recommended_action: Review and adjust the forecasting process to address the systematic bias.

key_findings: The forecast this week was 244.6, and actual demand was 83.0.
Actual demand (83.0) was far from this queue's usual level of about 232.38, while the forecast (244.6) was about normal.
This queue is over-forecast in most recent weeks (typically about 232.4 actual against 283.4 forecast).
All 6 similar queues mostly moved the same way this week.
The forecast plan did not change this week.
The installed base (Final_upp_units) was 2677.0 this week vs a usual ~2149.88.
